articles.title: MEDITECH Expanse EHR now live in 43 HCA Healthcare Hospitals
articles.mainIdea: MEDITECH Expanse EHR now live in 43 HCA Healthcare Hospitals
articles.summary: Business Wire: MEDITECH Expanse EHR now live in 43 HCA Healthcare Hospitals. CANTON, Mass., January 13, 2026--MEDITECH has announced the go-live of the first large-scale wave of its enterprise-wide MEDITECH Expanse EHR implementations at HCA Healthcare, one of the nation’s leading providers of healthcare. This milestone brings the innovative, cloud-based system live at 43 hospitals across the HCA Healthcare network, a key step in supporting the goal of delivering care efficiently, consistently, and safely for the patients and communities HCA Healthcare serves.

articles.mainIdea: Why Healthcare’s Stock-Market Winners and Losers Could Soon Trade Places
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Why Healthcare’s Stock-Market Winners and Losers Could Soon Trade Places. Hospitals and other providers—businesses that make money on volume—thrived. The stock market reflected this divide with brutal clarity. Since early 2020, shares of hospital operator Tenet Healthcare have quintupled while HCA Healthcare has more than tripled.
